item.title: “Jason has had a meaningful impact on the Dallas …
item.description: Mike Curtis: Masai Ujiri on parting ways with Jason Kidd: “Jason has had a meaningful impact on the Dallas Mavericks, both as a Hall of Fame player and as the head coach who helped lead this franchise back to the NBA Finals.
